propositions: Bug tickets currently short-circuit the plan-review gate to bare exempt-PASS with zero LLM calls, receiving no substantive review
FixedBench shows a 35-65% over-action result (plans adding mechanisms without establishing need) for which no plan-review criterion exists to flag lack of motivation

A new advisory pass-1 criterion 'necessity' must judge whether a plan demonstrates the change is needed (reproduction or motivation present), distinct from asserted-capability which checks for existing implementations
The bug review tier must run a lightweight advisory tier (DET floor + necessity probe only) for bugs instead of exempting them, never blocking a bug verdict
Both necessity criterion and bug tier must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and criteria_routing.json with advisory posture and auto-monitored by the standing recorder for later promotion to blocking
